theme_archetype: Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy (Traditional Islamic, Reverent, Calm)
core_principles: Typography is the Hero: Everything serves the Arabic text. The aesthetic is 'Digital Mushaf'.
Distraction-Free: The reading screen must be completely devoid of persistent UI chrome. No sticky headers.
Restrained Elegance: No gradients, no bright saturated colors. Use 'Old Paper' (#FBF8F1) and 'Aged Gold' accents.

rules.quran_text: Must have generous line height (e.g. 2.0 to 2.5 multiplier) to prevent Tashkeel (diacritics) from clipping. Text should be right-aligned or justified.
rules.ui_text: Used for buttons, surah names in the index, and settings.

quran_text.description: Highly responsive to font size +/- controls. Default 32px.

IndexScreen.description: List of Surahs with a prominent 'Continue Reading' button.

components.name: ContinueReadingButton
components.style: Large, prominent card at the top. Accent background or border. Contains last read Surah name.

components.name: SurahListItem
components.style: Clean rows, padding 16px, bottom border. Right-aligned Surah name, left-aligned verse count/icon.

ReadingScreen.layout: ScrollView (Do NOT use FlatList for individual verses to ensure text wraps and flows naturally like a physical book).

components.name: QuranTextContainer
components.style: Padding 24px. Contains the continuous text of the Surah. Verse numbers inline.

components.name: NextSurahButton
components.style: Simple outlined or flat button placed at the very end of the ScrollView.

components.name: SettingsBar
components.style: Hidden by default. Appears on tap. Contains Font +/- and Theme toggle.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize the app using React Native Expo. Use pure JS (.js files).
Implement RTL support. Use 'react-native' I18nManager.forceRTL(true) or style flexDirection: 'row-reverse' globally.
For the verse numbers, use the Arabic end of ayah symbol ۝ (U+06DD). Example format: ` ۝ ${verse_number} `.
Implement auto-save mechanism using '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage'. Save the current Surah ID and scroll position offset when the user scrolls or leaves the screen.
The reading text must be a continuous string or inline text components wrapped in a single <Text> node, so that it flows exactly like a physical Quran.
Ensure 'day/night' toggle updates colors across the app without requiring a restart.
Data must be completely offline. Load a local JSON file containing the Quran text.
Hide the status bar or make it translucent on the reading screen to maximize distraction-free reading.

icons.description: Use purely text-based Islamic symbols or simple Expo vector icons (e.g., Feather/Ionicons) for settings/font-size.
